You press folded cloth against the cut and tie it tight with your teeth and free hand.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self or one adjacent willing creature.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a free hand and cloth; grants no item.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Recovery

Reduce temporary Bleeding by 1, minimum 0. This does not treat the underlying wound or remove a starred contribution. It restores no HP.
